remarks_1999: Whitney Archive in 1969 indicates, "I believe that this is the ptg. I saw in the N.Y. warehouse 3/19/70, which David Workman had owned, but turned in in exchange." The work referred to as exchanged is cat. no. 1275. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
